Subject: Security intake: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & trust portal access

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and the checklist items we discussed so your security/compliance team can proceed: 

- Redwood is committed to providing the SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) and a bridge letter if needed.
- We can initiate a Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ) or accept your intake form — whichever you prefer.
- We support HIPAA data processing requirements and have options for EU data residency; happy to confirm specifics.
- To speed handoff, please provision a trust portal invite (or share an upload link) so we can push artifacts securely.

Action items for your team:
1) Please confirm whether you need HIPAA-only, HIPAA+GDPR, or additional regulatory controls.
2) Add security-intake@novamed.com and olga.petrov@redwood.com to the portal invite.
3) If you prefer the VSQ, please indicate whether an XLSX or online form is easier.

Attachments I'm sending with this message: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (blank VSQ), redwood_bridgeletter_template.pdf, sow-draft.docx (demo SOW).

Target timelines: ideally we can get portal access within 48 hours and the initial VSQ back within one week. Let me know if your legal needs a DPA before we share reports.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

—
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear recap and for the attachments. A few quick answers from my side: 

- NovaMed will need the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter covering the period that overlaps our projected go-live (Q3).
- HIPAA applies; GDPR will apply only if we store EU resident patient data. Please confirm whether Redwood persists ePHI beyond transient inference (we design workload to avoid storage, but we need confirmation).
- We prefer to use our intake PDF (attached) — I've filled basic vendor details and attached novamed_vendor_intake_filled.pdf.

Portal: I will ask IT/security to provision a TrustPortal upload link and include security-intake@novamed.com and olga.petrov@redwood.com. They may take until tomorrow morning.

One ask: can someone on your side confirm the right legal contact for a DPA? We will need that contact to move forward.

Thanks,
Laura

Hi Laura —

Appreciate the filled intake form — I took a look and wanted to confirm a couple of points to speed delivery: 

1) Data persistence: Redwood's hosted API can be configured to avoid persistent storage of inference inputs/outputs by default. For our Hosted API we do not retain customer inference data beyond short-term caching (KV cache used only for active sessions); for Dedicated/Private deployments persistence policies can be adjusted per contract. If you need formal language, I can have our Compliance team provide the exact DPA clause.

2) Bridge letter and SOC2 report: attached is our redwood_bridgeletter_template.pdf (editable) and the SOC2 identifier for internal tracking is SOC2-TypeII-2025. We can provide the full report once we execute the DPA or under your NDA — let us know which your legal prefers.

3) VSQ: if you'd like an online form we can send a pre-filled link (https://forms.redwood.example/vendor-questionnaire/DEAL-3479) or we can accept the XLSX you filled.

Next steps I propose:
- Laura/Novamed: confirm DPA path (DPA-first or report-under-NDA).
- Novamed IT: provision TrustPortal invite to: security-intake@novamed.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com. Portal URL we use for uploads: https://trust.redwood.example/portal/invite/novamed-3479
- Redwood: Ben to coordinate compliance handoff and deliver bridge letter draft within 48 hours after portal access/DPA confirmation.

Attachments: redwood_bridgeletter_template.pdf (draft), vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (blank).

If useful I can loop in our Legal contact (counsel@redwood.com) — say the word and I'll introduce.
